sentences.en: He fetched a few cushions to prop up her head.
sentences.zh: 他拿来几个垫子来支撑她的头部。

sentences.en: The cushions on the sofa don't match those on the armchairs.
sentences.zh: 沙发上的垫子和扶手椅上的垫子不相配。

sentences.en: The old woman was snugly sitting on a cushion.
sentences.zh: 那位老妇人舒舒服服地坐在一个垫子上。

senses.zh: 垫子，坐垫；减震垫，缓冲垫；起缓解作用的东西；大比分领先，稳操胜券；（台球桌的）弹性衬边
